fields.description: When on, locking a Sales Plan for Production creates every department Production Plan. When off, locking creates nothing and the manager creates plans by hand from the Sales Plan UI.
fields.label: Auto-create Production Plans on Lock for Production

fields.description: What happens when a Sales Plan is Returned to Draft or Cancelled while a live (non-cancelled) Production Plan is linked to it. Block is recommended.
fields.label: Sales Plan Return/Cancel with Live Production Plan

fields.description: When on, a sellable item can only be planned for a branch if it is on an enabled URY Menu for that branch. Non-sellable (semi-finished) items are exempt.
fields.label: Require Active Menu Item for Sales Plan Items

fields.description: A department Production Plan's execution job is recoverable only when its heartbeat (custom_ury_execution_heartbeat) has been stale for longer than this many minutes AND its recorded job is confirmed no longer running in the queue. This is a heartbeat staleness threshold, not a total-runtime limit -- a long-running job that keeps updating its heartbeat is never considered stuck.
fields.label: Production Job Stale (minutes)
